summary: ChdgAI Commodities Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, presenting unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The report details a 117.1% revenue increase to $194,649, operating income of $22,073 versus a prior-year loss, a return to net income of $14,271, and $4,978 of cash and equivalents. Management commentary highlights investments in intangible assets and continued focus on customer diversification. This is a routine interim earnings disclosure — a standard foreign private issuer reporting obligation — not a special-situations corporate action.
